items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And I'll mention Ralph Collins is also here

ctx.x: I'll make a note on here that we're interviewing Mr. Batiste Mosley at his home. What is the address? 1334 Pacific. 1334 Pacific in Algiers. And the date is September the 23rd, 1961. And I'll mention Ralph Collins is also here and this is Bill Russell. Do you mind giving your full name? Yeah, my name is John B. Mosley. John B.
